title: Wyoming Statutes, Title 26 - Insurance Code, Chapter 13 - Trade Practices and Frauds, Article 1 - Unfair Trade Practices Act
source_id: Wyo. Stat. Ann. tit. 26, ch. 13, art. 1 (ss 26-13-101 through 26-13-125); claims handling at s 26-13-124
verified_how: walked the LSO NXT table of contents (gateway.dll?f=xmlcontents&command=getchildren) down to 'TITLE 26 - INSURANCE CODE' > 'CHAPTER 13 - TRADE PRACTICES AND FRAUDS' > 'ARTICLE 1 - UNFAIR TRADE PRACTICES ACT', running from '26-13-101. Short title.' to '26-13-125. Certificates of insurance.', and containing '26-13-124. Unfair claims settlement practices.' (the neighbouring '26-13-123. Repealed by Laws 1995, ch. 175, s 2.' shows the register flags repeals inline, and 26-13-124 is not so flagged). Repealed sections are shown in the same listing with a 'Repealed by Laws ...' catchline (e.g. '37-3-103. Repealed by Laws 1995, ch. 192, s 3.'), so the substantive catchlines above are live text. Currency: the LSO's Statutes Download page states 'This version of the Wyoming Statutes contains changes from the 2026 Budget Session and reflects the contents of the statutes as they exist as of July 1, 2026'; the NXT infobase I browsed is the one labelled '2026 Wyoming Statutes' (the register also keeps 2020-2025 as separate historical infobases). Official title PDF at https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title26.pdf.
notes: s 26-13-124 is the claims-handling provision a Wyoming policyholder relies on. The chapter's other articles are art. 2 False Applications, Claims and Proof of Loss and art. 3 Discretionary Clause Prohibition Act. Policy cancellation and non-renewal are in ch. 35; insurer insolvency in ch. 28 and the guaranty association in ch. 31.
